title: Granular, Drums and Pluck synths
thisBuild: Three more kinds on the Synth tab, so there are six: Analog, FM, Wavetable, Granular, Drums and Pluck.

Granular plays a sound from your mess as a cloud of tiny grains, at any pitch. Grains of picks the sound (any sound on a pad). Position is where in it, Spray scatters them, Size and Density shape the cloud, Scan crawls through the sound while you hold, Pitch spray and Reverse add sparkle. Presets: Cloud, Freeze, Crawl, Shimmer, Stutter, Backwards wash, Glitch.

Drums are made from scratch: pick a model (Kick, Snare, Hat, Open hat, Clap, Tom, Cowbell, Zap), then Tune, Decay, Tone and Snap; Sweep and Sweep time bend kicks, toms and zaps. They are one-shots, and on keys they go up and down in pitch. Presets include Deep kick, Punch kick, Boom 808, Rim snare and Cowbell.
Pluck is a plucked string: Bright is the pick, Damp the string, Body the wood, Let go how fast it stops when you lift. Presets: Nylon, Steel, Harp, Koto, Pluck bass, Muted, Bell string.
The kind buttons now wrap onto two lines on narrow screens.
watch: Make a Granular synth from a long sound (a chord or a vocal) and hold a note while you move Position.
Put Drums on four pads (kick, snare, hat, clap) and program a beat: compare them with the sample drums.
Play Nylon and Harp on keys: high notes should stay in tune.
Check the Latency screen's load with a busy Granular Shimmer chord.
limits: Granular reads sounds that are on a pad in this mess; picking from the whole library comes later.
Drums ignore Hold and Sustain: they always play once.
Next in the plan: the Loops shelf, re-cut chops, and the RC-505 library.
